newsitem.title: UK: Capital and Regional buys retail parks.
newsitem.headline: Capital and Regional buys retail parks.

text.p: Capital and Regional Properties Plc said on Thursday that one of its units, Capital and Lanham Retail Parks Ltd, had acquired three retail parks from the Hermes Pension Fund for 21.93 million stg, after expenses.
In a statement, the group said the purchase consideration has been financed partly by an 18.4 million stg loan from the Royal Bank of Scotland and partly from existing cash resources.
The three parks -- in Nottingham, Fareham and Bristol -- cover 245,000 square feet. They produce 1.75 million stg rental income a year.
"Capital and Regional's associate Lanham Plc would be responsible for implementing the asset enhancement strategy for the parks", the company said.
Capital and Lanham Retail Parks Ltd is a 75-25 joint venture between Capital and Regional and Lanham Plc.
